artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Numbers and fixed words only, assembled by ev4_build.py from the host driver record: six variants of a three-page transactions chain, median growth per page A 135.9, B 146.8, C 110.7, D 26.7, E 104.5, F 42.4 MB; flattening variant none.
The read-only host measurement: the release app staged in a scratch folder (removed), each variant in a fresh process, a 78 percent kill and a 75 percent stop, the service untouched.
The host driver record the measurement was assembled from.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: AC1: the record is complete and self-consistent: six variants with numeric pages, each median recomputed from its pages, the flattening variant following the stated rule, and nothing but numbers and fixed words in it.

acceptance.denominator: six variants (A to F), three pages each, none stopped; idle host 28.1 percent used; the highest host reading 69.5 percent.

determinism.method: AC1 was run twice against the same record, back to back.

mutant.description: The order names no mutant. The discriminating arms are the issuer's pre-cut controls (a verdict naming B when C is flatter; none though C is flat; a median that differs from the pages; F missing; an e-mail in the record); the measurement's own discriminator is variant A, the release as is, which reproduced the growth OG-ap-32 found (135.9 MB per page against 110 to 165).
mutant.expected: A shows the retention that OG-ap-32 measured; a mitigation shows a lower median
mutant.observed: A 135.9 MB per page; D 26.7; F 42.4

declared_exclusions.item: a combination of D and F, and more than three pages
declared_exclusions.reason: The order fixes six variants and one chain of three pages each, no loops; D's third growth (3.2 MB) suggests flattening that three pages cannot separate from noise.

surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-S342: OBSERVATION -- the retained memory sits in glibc's per-thread arenas; MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 cuts the median growth from 135.9 to 26.7 MB per page; no variant meets the 20 MB rule.
